title: 生命と安全(再履修クラス)
subtitle: Life and Safety
educationalGoal: According to the remarkable progress in science and technology, we face safety issues in areas such as experiments and manufacturing. Students will learn safety management and hygiene management.
advice: Students will learn about safety management for experiments at KIT and safety management for social activities. 1. Imminent safety 2. Bioscience and safety 3. Food and safety 4. Hygiene and safety 5. Chemicals and safety 6. Dangerous substances and safety
requiredKnowledge: Students will be required to collect information on current issues related to safety management on a daily basis.

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand the concept and reality of biosafety.
Ability to understand food safety and health management systems.
Ability to understand the characteristics and handling of dangerous substances.
Ability to communicate your thoughts in an easy-to-understand manner.

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
